contexts.text: The sons of Shem, Elam and Asshur, etc. ()... Elam, Asshur, etc., were so many nations, by which are signified those things which are of wisdom: by Elam, faith from charity. AC 1227.

That Elam = faith from charity, or that faith itself which constitutes the internal Church, is evident from . Here, under the name of Elam, faith is treated of, or, what is the same, the internal Church become perverted and corrupt; and then concerning the same restored... So in , Elam = the internal Church.
Chedorlaomer king of Elam, etc. () = so many kinds of apparent goods and truths. AC 1685.

Elam = faith from charity; here, therefore, truth and good; for faith, and the things which belong to faith, are nothing but truths; and charity, and the things which belong to charity, are goods; here, however, the goods of infancy, which, although they appear to be goods, are not goods...
The desolation of the Spiritual Church is here treated of (); the diversities of which Church are mentioned in order, and are signified by... Elam, etc.
Behold, I break the bow of Elam, the beginning of his power (). By Elam is meant the knowledge which is of the natural man, and the confidence thence derived.

Upon Elam I will bring the four winds from the four ends of the heavens, and I will scatter him into all these winds, so that there shall be no nation whither the outcasts of Elam shall not come (). By Elam, here, are signified those who are in the Knowledges which are said to be of faith, and are not at the same time in any charity...
Elam, and all the uncircumcised slain with the sword () = the Hells where are these falsities, that is, those who are in such falsities.
